scope: bounded paired diagnostic, not superiority benchmark or prospective independent validation
selection: All three existing Boltz-pass candidates; one positive and one negative per each of five public targets by salted ID hash, independent of AF2 scores. Ten controls, four conservative family groups; insufficient for precise sensitivity/specificity.

prediction.msa: reuse pinned target MSA and single binder, BBF14 target single sequence

comparison: model1 same seeds paired with historical max3-recycle predictions; all15 summarized by model and seed, never best-model-only; missing bb145 legacy arm must be generated

scoring.legacy_thresholds: unchanged and reported on raw structures
axes: native epitope coverage for candidates only
minimum distance and interchain heavy-atom overlap
scoring.relaxation_gate: No automatic rescue or promotion; retain raw clashes and failed relaxations. Report backbone versus sidechain clashes separately; no claim of MolProbity clashscore.
scoring.controls: author design geometry is recovery only, never native competition

promotion: None. No gate tuning on these three candidates; binding is not blockade; scaffold/target independence unestablished.
